prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Webflow Website Developer
We need someone to join our team to help with the ability to design and build great websites using webflow. Requirements -Design beautiful websites -Very skilled at using Webflow -Able to build websites quickly -Design intuitive user experiences -high-fidelity website design -Very responsive -Fast turnaround -Excellent communication skills Extras -Front-end development -Experience with CSS, JS and React
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building clean, user-focused web applications.

I’m interested in your Webflow Website Developer role because it sits right at the intersection of design quality, fast execution, and strong front-end implementation. While my core background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I’m comfortable working in environments where polished visuals and intuitive user experiences are just as important as the underlying build.

What I’d bring to your team is a strong front-end mindset, a careful approach to UI details, and the ability to move quickly without losing quality. I understand how important it is to translate a design into a website that feels refined, responsive, and easy to use. I also value clear communication and consistent collaboration, especially when turnaround time matters and quick feedback loops are needed.

Your listing mentions high-fidelity website design, responsiveness, and speed, which are all priorities I work well with. I’m used to building interfaces that are structured, modern, and practical, and I’m comfortable adapting to design systems and evolving requirements. If there’s a need for front-end development support alongside Webflow work, my experience with CSS, JavaScript, and React should be directly useful.

I’d be glad to help your team create websites that look great, work smoothly, and deliver a strong user experience. If you’re looking for someone reliable, responsive, and able to contribute quickly, I’d love to discuss how I can support your next build.
